parameters.subject: ⚠️ Shorts Queue Empty — Auto-Triggered GTA 6 Scraper!
parameters.html:
={{ (function(){ const esc = s => String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"'); const scan = $('Scan & Rank Output Queue').first().json || {}; const proc = Array.isArray(scan.processing_files) ? scan.processing_files.join(', ') : ''; return '

⚠️ Shorts Queue Is Empty

' + '

Action Taken: ' + (scan.is_generator_processing ? 'VOD already processing in /files/inputs/ (' + esc(proc) + ') — skipped duplicate launch.' : 'No active VOD processing detected — auto-triggered Gta6VisionShortsV1 headlessly (' + esc(String($json.stdout || '').trim()) + ').') + '

' + '

Daily API Quota Used: ' + esc(scan.uploads_today) + '/6

' + '

Log file: /files/temp/gen_run.log

'; })() }}
